# llmbench summary scores

The packaged `llmbench_catalog_ranking.json` is an open-model subset of
llmbench's published `llmbench-summary-scores.csv`, matched to model
repositories from `llmbench-models.csv`.

Both source files were downloaded from https://llmbench.site/data/ at
2026-11-17T21:02:32Z. The summary method is documented at
https://llmbench.site/summary/. llmbench's compilation is CC BY-SA 4.0 and
incorporates whatmodel.sh by Merlinsbeard Pty Ltd. Underlying benchmark
sources retain their own licenses.

See `docs/archive/runs/2026-11-17-llmbench-summary-scores.md` for the captured
file hashes and promotion scope.
